# ARKhives 8.19.5

The main desktop workspaces now align to the same content grid. Page headings, toolbars and panels use shared spacing and surfaces.

- The dashboard reflows without cutting off the cards when the window gets narrower.
- The desktop header gives the optional player its own space.
- Reviewer search, display options and Smart practice sit on the same grid as the cards.
- Admin navigation, account filters and the account table align with the rest of the workspace.
- Settings, Analytics, Profile and Achievements use a consistent treatment for tabs and panels.
- Desktop and mobile use the original reviewer icons, including Plumbing, Building Utilities and Structural.
